caption: The drawing depicts a single knitted slipper or soft shoe positioned in the center of the image, oriented so that the toe points to the left. The slipper is rendered in shades of beige, cream, and light brown, showing detailed textures that indicate a woven or knitted fabric. The upper part of the slipper has a ribbed and patterned appearance, with a small loop or lace extending from one side. The background of the drawing is off-white with subtle discoloration and faint brownish areas, especially around the edges. There is also a hand-written name, "Sara Garfinkel," in small print on the left side below the slipper. No other objects or decorative elements are present in the composition.
title: Infant's Booties
